int_name: N BROAD ST & W BUTLER ST

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban street with a high-visibility marked crosswalk at a signalized intersection. While sidewalks and basic markings are present, the long crossing distance and lack of a pedestrian refuge island increase exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic and parking without a midway refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signalization
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible to indicate when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install countdown pedestrian signals to provide clear guidance on crossing times.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with high-visibility continental crosswalks and pedestrian signals, providing basic infrastructure for walkers. However, the wide roadway lacks physical traffic calming measures such as curb extensions or a median refuge, which increases pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of corner protection
hazards.description: The wide turning radii at the corners may allow vehicles to turn at higher speeds near pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection corners near the church and commercial lot.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalk markings and overhead traffic signals. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the long crossing distance across multiple lanes without a median refuge increases exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk spanning the width of the roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the right may block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb line

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sight lines.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features wide sidewalks and marked crosswalks in a commercial setting. However, the large intersection area and presence of parked cars near the crossing points create visibility and exposure risks for pedestrians, particularly those with mobility aids.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb near the intersection can block the line of sight between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the corner building.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Exposure
hazards.description: The wide intersection area increases the time pedestrians, particularly those with mobility aids, are exposed to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk area where pedestrians are visible.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing parallel line crosswalks to continental or ladder patterns to increase visibility to approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.
